SELECT
  (SELECT pv.product_sku FROM product_variants pv WHERE pv.brand = 'Wurth' AND pv.series = 'Wurth Universal ZEBRA 2RS-7GT Wood and Drywall Screw' AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product_variant_properties pvp WHERE pvp.product_sku = pv.product_sku AND ( (pvp.property_key = 'screw type' AND pvp.property_value_text = 'wood screw') OR (pvp.property_key = 'diameter' AND pvp.property_value_text = '3 mm') OR (pvp.property_key = 'length' AND pvp.property_value_text = '30 mm') OR (pvp.property_key = 'drive type' AND pvp.property_value_text = 'torx') ) ) = 4) AS product_sku,
  (SELECT pv.record_path FROM product_variants pv WHERE pv.brand = 'Wurth' AND pv.series = 'Wurth Universal ZEBRA 2RS-7GT Wood and Drywall Screw' AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product_variant_properties pvp WHERE pvp.product_sku = pv.product_sku AND ( (pvp.property_key = 'screw type' AND pvp.property_value_text = 'wood screw') OR (pvp.property_key = 'diameter' AND pvp.property_value_text = '3 mm') OR (pvp.property_key = 'length' AND pvp.property_value_text = '30 mm') OR (pvp.property_key = 'drive type' AND pvp.property_value_text = 'torx') ) ) = 4) AS product_record_path,
  (SELECT COALESCE(json_group_array(json_object('record_path', record_path)), '[]') FROM stores WHERE city = 'Graz') AS store_record_paths,
  (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(si.available_today_quantity), 0) FROM store_inventory si WHERE si.product_sku = (SELECT pv.product_sku FROM product_variants pv WHERE pv.brand = 'Wurth' AND pv.series = 'Wurth Universal ZEBRA 2RS-7GT Wood and Drywall Screw' AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product_variant_properties pvp WHERE pvp.product_sku = pv.product_sku AND ( (pvp.property_key = 'screw type' AND pvp.property_value_text = 'wood screw') OR (pvp.property_key = 'diameter' AND pvp.property_value_text = '3 mm') OR (pvp.property_key = 'length' AND pvp.property_value_text = '30 mm') OR (pvp.property_key = 'drive type' AND pvp.property_value_text = 'torx') ) ) = 4) AND si.store_id IN (SELECT store_id FROM stores WHERE city = 'Graz')) AS total_available;
